headline: Türkiye Targets Record $3 Billion in EBRD Investments by End of 2026
summary: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development has invested 2.5 billion euros in Türkiye this year, including 1.7 billion in green projects, targeting $3 billion total by year-end.
why: Multilateral development bank funding supports infrastructure, green transition, and economic stability in emerging markets.

entities.name: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development
